# CXNM - Standard - WIN - D - Defender for Endpoint EDR

Connects the device to Defender for Endpoint via the Defender connector; same onboarding as CXNM - Standard - WIN - D - Defender EDR Policy, plus an explicit telemetry reporting frequency (normal).

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog (endpointSecurityEndpointDetectionAndResponse) |
| Assignment | — |
| Source | own baseline — OpenIntuneBaseline has no EDR onboarding policy |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Defender_for_Endpoint_EDR.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Defender_for_Endpoint_EDR.json) |
